thought: Dusk on Throop Ave, the sky going deep blue with pink clouds, and the street lamps are just coming on. There's a white SUV on my left about five metres off. I'll turn toward it and walk over.
I'm in the SUV. The radio is on WBED 88.9, Brownstone Boom-Bap, and the camera sits right behind the hood. I'll ease off and roll up the avenue.
